directAnswer.en: This is a pipe trench or a short pipeline placement. The printed line is 120 m horizontal / 360 m vertical. This page does not print a separate aggregate cell. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Diesel 40 at diesel 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa, 120 m horizontal / 360 m vertical, hopper 0.4 m³, Kawasaki 112, 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm and 2800 kg. Do not move the same condition onto Diesel 30, which prints diesel 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa, 60 m horizontal / 180 m vertical, aggregate 3 cm and below, hopper 0.3 m³, 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm and 2000 kg. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.

body.en: Send the mix, the largest stone, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical line you measured, and confirm the site cannot feed the matching electric motor. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job, a price or a daily volume.
body.zh: 请发送配合比、最大石子、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，并确认现场供不上对应的电动电机。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。

question.en: Is the photograph a Pinjin jobsite?

answer.en: No. It shows this kind of work. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not name it as a contract record.
answer.zh: 不是。它表示的是这类工况。河北品锦机械没有把它写成合同记录。
